recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有兩個大型巨噬細胞，胞質豐富、淡藍色並呈細纖維狀或皺紙樣紋理，其中一個含吞噬的核碎片；周圍混有芽細胞與骨髓前驅細胞，為急性骨髓性白血病中的類 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Two large histiocytes with abundant pale-to-deep blue, finely fibrillar/wrinkled cytoplasm
Small round to oval eccentric nuclei in the histiocytes; one contains phagocytosed nuclear debris
Surrounding blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed granulocytic precursors with coarse chromatin and small mature lymphocytes/erythroid precursors
Gaucher-like cells are the focus; no Auer rod is clearly seen in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large macrophages with abundant, finely fibrillar to wrinkled blue cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, one containing phagocytosed nuclear debris. These resemble Gaucher cells (pseudo-Gaucher cells). The background contains numerous blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, together with maturing granulocytic precursors and scattered lymphocytes. In the setting of acute myeloid leukemia, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells secondary to high cell turnover.

ddx.vs: Gaucher disease lacks an associated blast population and is confirmed by deficient glucocerebrosidase activity or GBA1 mutation.
HLH macrophages show engulfed intact erythrocytes, platelets, or leukocytes with vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillar striated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma, or thalassemia
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so the underlying disease (blast count, BCR-ABL1, plasma cells, hemoglobin studies) is the discriminator.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes show negative-image striations and are acid-fast positive, requiring AFB stain to exclude.
